pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Walker Blue Ninja Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay Walker, the Blue Ninja, stands ready in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing a face mask, angular armor panels, and a tied waist sash. His curved minifigure hands rest at his sides beneath a shoulder guard. Thick outlines, block-shaped legs, and broad background bands create clear spaces around the full character.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay with Lightning Powers Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay uses lightning powers in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising one hand as branching bolts surround both arms beneath curling cloud shapes behind him. His mask reveals focused eyes above a wrap-front uniform and knotted belt. The jagged electricity contrasts with rounded hands, smooth sleeves, and the figure's rectangular feet.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Holding Nunchucks Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay holds nunchucks in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, lifting one handle beside his head while another chain-linked section hangs down near his shoulder. His other hand grips a handle at waist height. A face covering, tied sash, block-shaped legs, and simple paneled training-room background keep the weapon practice pose clearly defined.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Zx Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay ZX holds chain-linked nunchucks in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing shoulder armor and a mask beneath an arched frame with small cloud outlines. Lightning symbols decorate his wrap-front uniform and legs. The chunky chain loops, cylindrical handles, and knotted sash give the central minifigure several distinct details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Dx Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay DX stands facing forward in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a crested mask, segmented shoulder guards, and a tied sash beneath his uniform. Round fastenings and angular motifs decorate the torso. Broad rectangular legs, curved hands, and a few simple background blocks leave clear open sections around the armor details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Using Lightning Spinjitzu Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay uses lightning Spinjitzu in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, lifting one leg as sweeping rings of energy wrap around his masked minifigure body. Jagged bolts interrupt the curved bands, and curled clouds float nearby. His knotted sash, uniform panels, and block feet remain visible between the swirling shapes.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Ninja Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay's ninja mask fills this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, featuring focused eyes beneath a raised forehead crest marked with a large outlined lightning bolt. Curved layers cover the cheeks and mouth below the narrow eye opening. Thick contours and broad mask sections give this close-up emblem a simple, clearly enclosed structure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay and Nya Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay and Nya stand together in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing lower-face masks and tied uniforms while holding nunchucks and a long staff. Their uncovered hairstyles distinguish the pair, with Nya's hair gathered in a bun. Lightning shapes, broad building outlines, and clouds frame the two armed minifigures.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay Fighting Nadakhan in Season 6 Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay fights Nadakhan in this Lego Ninjago Season 6 printable coloring page, swinging chain-linked nunchucks toward a floating opponent with a turban and curved sword. Nadakhan's multiple arms and curling lower body rise above clouds. A ship's mast appears below, while Jay's uncovered hair, mask, and sash define the airborne ninja.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Movie Jay Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay from The Lego Ninjago Movie appears in this printable coloring page, shown in a close portrait with swept hair above a folded lower-face mask. Two lightning symbols decorate the wrap-front uniform beneath his focused eyes. Thick contours and broad torso panels make the head, hair, and costume the main coloring areas.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay in Sea of Sand Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay stands in the Sea of Sand in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding chain-linked nunchucks beside his leg amid layered dunes stretching behind him. Clouds and a round sun sit above the distant sand. His wrapped hood, shoulder armor, lightning chest emblem, belt, and leg bands provide the central details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay in Jamanakai Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay visits Jamanakai Village in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing beneath a gateway with nunchuck handles hanging from both hands at his sides. Tiled roofs, lanterns, mountains, and a shaped tree surround him. Lightning motifs, knee panels, a crossed chest strap, and the knotted sash distinguish the masked minifigure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay in City Gardens Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay stands in City Gardens in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a sword beside a lantern-hung building with curved roofs and nearby tree branches. Stud-shaped leaf connections give the setting a brick-built appearance. His lightning forehead emblem, shoulder guards, wrapped legs, and sash add smaller costume sections.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay in Lost City of Ouroboros Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay explores the Lost City of Ouroboros in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding nunchucks before cracked stone ruins and a panel decorated with a snake. A large lightning emblem crosses his armored torso. Rounded shoulder guards, a folded mask, a knotted belt, and uneven paving complete the ancient-city scene.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Jay in Temple of Light Coloring Page
pages.description: Jay stands in the Temple of Light in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising chain-linked weapons beside a lightning medallion fastened across his chest. Patterned columns flank a tall arch, with a radiant symbol above his head. Shoulder armor, a tied sash, tiled flooring, and small masonry cracks add detail around the figure.
